dict.string: Lucid listens to the sound your Mac is playing (never the microphone) so audio-reactive wallpapers can move with your music. The sound is analysed on this Mac and is never recorded or sent anywhere. You can turn this off in Lucid's Settings.

Lucid uses your approximate location to work out today's sunrise and sunset for Day/Night wallpapers. It stays on this Mac, except that if you also turn on Weather wallpapers, a rounded version (about 10 km) is sent to Open-Meteo to look up the weather.

Lucid uses your approximate location to work out today's sunrise and sunset for Day/Night wallpapers. It stays on this Mac, except that if you also turn on Weather wallpapers, a rounded version (about 10 km) is sent to Open-Meteo to look up the weather.
